title: FinanceFlow
tagline: Your money. All of it. In one place.
summary: A multi-currency expense tracker and finance dashboard. Track naira, dollars, euros and more, each transaction in its own currency, with budgets, charts, reports and exports.
problem: Managing money across several currencies usually means converting everything by hand and losing track of what was really spent.
note: Free hosting: the first load can take about 30 seconds.
features: Each transaction stays in its own currency, never blended
Per-currency KPI cards: balance, income, expense, savings rate
4 Chart.js charts with a currency switcher
Monthly budgets per category and currency, with radial progress
PDF report, CSV and 3-sheet Excel export
Email sign-up or Google sign-in; your data is only yours
why: Most budgeting apps convert everything into one currency and call it done. I built FinanceFlow so naira, dollars and euros each stay in their own currency end to end — budgets, charts and reports included — because a converted total hides what was really spent.
hard: Totals, KPIs, budgets and charts are all computed per currency, so ₦ and $ never land in one sum.
12-month trends, 6-month predictions with a weighted moving average, and PDF, CSV and Excel exports.
Email or Google sign-in, with every query scoped to the signed-in user.
